nodes.label: Dependabot configuration
nodes.rationale: Two ecosystems, both daily at 06:00 Europe/Berlin: npm (label dependencies, commit prefix chore(deps)) and github-actions (labels dependencies + github-actions, prefix chore(actions)).

nodes.label: npm minor+patch update group
nodes.rationale: Groups minor and patch bumps into one PR per ecosystem per day rather than 15; major bumps still get their own PR so they can be eyeballed individually.

nodes.label: @types/node major-bump ignore rule
nodes.rationale: @types/node deliberately tracks the engines support floor (24), not latest, so a newer-Node API cannot slip in unnoticed. Nothing in the toolchain catches the violation - with the major bump applied, both typecheck and the full suite stay green, because the pin's whole job is to make those APIs unrepresentable at compile time. Without the rule the same PR kept returning (#334, #336, #340, #374, #481, #906).

nodes.label: SHA-pinned actions with trailing tag comment
nodes.rationale: Every uses: is a full 40-character commit SHA plus a trailing # vX.Y.Z comment (#585). A tag is a mutable pointer - whoever can move actions/checkout@v7 runs arbitrary code inside the publish job that holds id-token: write. The comment is load-bearing, not decoration: Dependabot reads it to learn which version a SHA stands for, and without it the pin is invisible to updates and the repository freezes on a stale, eventually vulnerable action.
